# digi systems

## Summary
Digi Systems is a digital product studio that builds web-based software solutions and product experiences. The public website introduces the company’s offerings, privacy information, and an authenticated application area for managing users and projects.

## Main pages
- [Home](/): Landing page with the company overview and product highlights.
- [About](/about): Company information and product-oriented narrative.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Privacy and legal information.
- [Login](/auth/login): Authentication entry point for the application.
- [Application Home](/app): Authenticated workspace for app users.
- [Projects](/app/projects): Project management area.
- [Users](/app/users): User management and profile area.

## Product highlights
- Digi Sky: Cloud storage and file organization solution.
- Digi Calendar: Scheduling and planning experience.
- Other offerings: Digital products and software solutions for modern workflows.

## Notes for AI agents
- The public site is primarily marketing and navigation.
- The main functional experience is behind authenticated routes under /app.
- Important user-facing flows include authentication, profile editing, and project management.
